exit 0
--- stdout
Write Liza contracts, skills, and support docs to ~/.liza/ for global access.
This is a one-time setup step that populates the global config directory.
Contracts are written flat (e.g., ~/.liza/CORE.md) and skills are written
to ~/.liza/skills/. Installable support docs are written to
~/.liza/support-docs/.
After running setup, use 'liza init' in each project to create the
project-local blackboard and symlinks.
Use --force to overwrite an existing global config.
Use --agent-tools to install a custom AGENT_TOOLS.md instead of the embedded default.
Usage:
liza setup [flags]
Flags:
--agent-tools string path to custom AGENT_TOOLS.md (replaces embedded default)
--claude create skill symlinks in ~/.claude/
--codex create skill symlinks in ~/.codex/
--copilot create skill symlinks in ~/.copilot/
--cursor create Claude/Codex skill symlinks Cursor relies on
--force overwrite existing global config
--gemini create skill symlinks in ~/.gemini/
-h, --help help for setup
--mistral create skill symlinks in ~/.vibe/
--opencode create skill symlinks in ~/.config/opencode/
--pi create skill symlinks in ~/.pi/agent/ and install the pi init-gate extension
--provider stringArray create setup links for provider catalog id (repeatable)
--yes auto-confirm setup approval prompts
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
